name: simple-walk
description: A horizontal one tile corridor with the player on the left and exit on the right

name: complex-path-switch-required
description: A map with many different tile types, as well as one way platforms, that includes two necessary locked doors that need to be opened, as well as a trap door switch that should not be triggered. Triggering this trap door to close will make the exit door unreachable

name: wall-jump-required
description: A map where a wall jump is required to reach the exit switch and then fall to the exit door

name: fall-required
description: A map where the player must fall down to reach the exit, testing vertical movement and fall mechanics

name: jump-then-fall
description: A map requiring the player to jump up first, then fall down to reach the exit, testing combined jump and fall mechanics

name: long-jump-reachable
description: A map with a long horizontal gap that can be crossed with a single jump, testing maximum jump distance

name: long-walk
description: A map with a long horizontal path that can be traversed by walking, testing basic movement mechanics

name: only-jump
description: A map where the player can only reach the exit by jumping, with no walking path available

name: halfaligned-path
description: A map where some tiles are misaligned with the main grid but the exit is still reachable

name: minefield
description: A map with toggled-on mines that the player must jump through; there is a reachable path from the player to the exit in this map

name: path-jump-required
description: A vertical corridor where the player starts at the bottom and must jump up to reach the exit switch and then keep jumping up to reach the exit door. Wall jumps are valid too.

name: thwump-platform-required
description: A map where the player must activate a thwump, wait until it is within distance to jump on, and then stand on the thwump as it climbs back to its origin. The exit switch and door will be reachable as the thwump climbs back to its origin.

name: long-vertical-corridor
description: A vertical corridor where the player starts at the bottom and must wall jump up to reach the exit switch and then keep wall jumping up to reach the exit door.

name: switch-puzzle-1
description: A level with narrow corridors in which the player must trigger various switches in the correct order to reach the exit.

name: switch-puzzle-2
description: Another switch puzzle similar to switch-puzzle-1

name: switch-simple
description: A one tile high level where the player can move right and unlock locked doors to reach the exit.

name: stumbleine
description: A complex open map requiring jumps across mine-sprinkled platforms and wall-jumps to achieve vertical height. Takes many frames to complete.

name: basics
description: A hairpin U-shaped corridor on the 42x23 grid: the ninja spawns at the right end of a lower horizontal corridor and must run left, wall-jump up the left boundary through a 3-tile vertical gap, then run right along an upper corridor past three toggle mines (one at the left edge of the middle platform, one mid-surface that must be jumped over, and one permanently-deadly at the far-right wall) to reach the exit switch, then backtrack a short distance left to the exit door. Tests non-trivial A* routing (the exit is right of spawn but the path goes left first), wall-jumping, mine avoidance, and momentum management / braking before the deadly right-wall mine. Full prose in nclone/test_maps/basics_description.md.

name: rampjump
description: A medium-difficulty open map that requires jumps off of ramps and precisely-timed jumps with velocity to clear a gap.

name: simple-3x1
description: A trivial level with a 3-tile-wide, 1-tile-tall playspace surrounded by solid tiles. The agent wins by going right, activating the middle switch, and intersecting with the exit door.

name: simplest-horizontal-path-3x1
description: A trivial level with the same 3x1 horizontal route as simple-3x1, except the route is located at the bottom-left corner of the map and all surrounding tiles are open (tile type 0) rather than solid.

name: simplest-vertical-1x3
description: A trivial level with a 1-tile-wide, 3-tile-tall playspace; the agent starts at the bottom and wins by jumping up to the exit.

name: slopes
description: A level composed primarily of sloped tiles, testing the ninja's traversal, sliding, and jump behavior on non-axis-aligned surfaces.
